```python
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
```

```python
def rotate_array(nums, k):
    n = len(nums)
    k %= n
    if k == 0:
        return nums

    def reverse(lst, start, end):
        while start < end:
            lst[start], lst[end] = lst[end], lst[start]
            start += 1
            end -= 1

    reverse(nums, 0, n - 1)
    reverse(nums, 0, k - 1)
    reverse(nums, k, n - 1)
    return nums
```
